name: carnitine palmitoyl transferase II deficiency, neonatal form
description: The neonatal form of carnitine palmitoyltransferase II (CPT II) deficiency, an inherited disorder that affects mitochondrial oxidation of long chain fatty acids (LCFA), is the lethal form of the disease which presents with multisystem failure.
